statement: Every one-sided smooth specialization of a fixed-pair family is its prescribed interior member and admits a local holomorphic family comparison
notes: Root and D full-source referee PASS. Finite affine lattice classes and collar Cech defects persist integrally; the holomorphic remainder is the actual V cocycle. The separate arbitrary-open-locus propagation is proved in E.2.22 and is used for arbitrary bases in E.2.23-E.2.24.
